Game Overview

In Chicken Ko, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Chicken Ko, a charming 2D platformer adventure as a daring chicken. Collect grain bowls and conquer increasingly challenging levels, all while dodging cunning enemies and perilous spikes. Master the exhilarating double jump to navigate vibrant landscapes and achieve victory at the red flag.
